types.name: Redemption could not be funded
types.description: A paid order was quoted more loyalty points than the customer's balance could cover, so only part of the redemption was charged. Somebody has to decide whether to honour the difference.

title.en: Order {{ order_number }} redeemed more points than were held

body.en: The order was priced with {{ quoted }} points off, but only {{ charged }} could be charged — a shortfall of {{ shortfall }}. The customer has already paid the reduced amount. Decide whether to absorb the difference or post a correcting entry.

types.name: Partial refund needs a points decision
types.description: An order was partially refunded. There is no defensible way to split the points automatically, so this asks an operator to make the call.

body.en: It earned {{ earned }} points and redeemed {{ redeemed }}. Points are not clawed back automatically for a partial refund, because how much to take back depends on which lines went back. Post an adjustment under Points Activity if this one needs correcting.
